Job Description

Quantum Realm Engineering is looking for a UX/UI Designer to help create websites, apps, dashboards, pitch decks, brochures and client-facing digital assets.

We are an Australian software, AI and digital product company working with start-ups, founders and growing businesses. Our work includes websites, web apps, mobile apps, AI systems, internal dashboards, customer portals, sales decks, brand refreshes and digital product concepts.

This role is suited to a designer who can think clearly, work fast, organise information properly and turn rough ideas into polished designs that clients can understand and use.

You will work closely with project managers, developers, marketers and company leadership to design digital products and supporting business material.

Role Focus

This role includes design work across:

  • Website designs and redesigns
  • Landing pages
  • Web apps and dashboards
  • Mobile apps
  • UX wireframes
  • User flows
  • Clickable prototypes
  • Pitch decks
  • Sales presentations
  • Investor decks
  • Company profiles
  • Service brochures
  • Capability decks
  • Social media assets
  • Brand refresh concepts
  • Design systems and reusable components
  • Client proposal visuals

Key Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be responsible for turning business, product and content requirements into clean, usable designs.

UX and Wireframing

Create user flows, page structures, wireframes and early product layouts.

Think through how users move through websites, apps, dashboards and portals before visual design begins.

Website and Landing Page Design

Design modern websites and landing pages for software, AI, business, hospitality, property, finance and service-based clients.

Make sure pages are easy to scan, commercially clear and structured for conversion.

App and Product Design

Design web app and mobile app screens for products such as dashboards, portals, AI tools, booking systems, internal business tools and customer-facing platforms.

Create layouts that are practical for developers to build.

Pitch Deck and Presentation Design

Design pitch decks, proposals, client presentations, investor decks and sales decks in Figma or PowerPoint.

Make dense content easier to understand through layout, spacing, visual hierarchy and better page structure.

Brochures and Brand Assets

Design company profiles, brochures, one-pagers, capability documents and branded client-facing material.

Keep designs consistent with each client’s tone, brand and commercial objective.

Figma Design Systems

Create organised Figma files with proper sections, components, naming, spacing and reusable elements.

Keep files clean enough for other designers, developers and project managers to use without confusion.

Developer Handover

Prepare designs so developers can build them properly.

This includes layout notes, component states, spacing logic, responsive behaviour and clear export-ready assets.

Client Revisions

Apply feedback carefully and improve designs without losing the original purpose of the project.

The role requires someone who can take feedback without becoming defensive.

  • Experience designing websites, landing pages and digital products
  • Experience designing web app or mobile app interfaces
  • Good understanding of responsive design

  • Good understanding of how design supports sales, trust and usability

  • Good English communication skills
  • Ability to work remotely and manage design tasks without constant supervision

  • Good at making complex information easier to understand

  • Comfortable working across multiple client brands
  • Able to move quickly without making messy work
  • Good at taking feedback and improving the design
  • Organised with files, components and naming

This Role Is Not For You If

  • You do not want to work on websites, apps or dashboards
  • You dislike PowerPoint or presentation design
  • You struggle to organise Figma files properly
  • You need every detail explained before starting
  • You ignore spacing, alignment or mobile responsiveness
  • You design screens that look good but are hard to build
  • You are uncomfortable with client feedback
  • You miss small details in text, layout or consistency

Additional Experience That Would Be a Plus

  • Brochures, company profiles or similar business documents
  • Any before-and-after redesign work

Department: Project Operations Department

Location: Jakarta, Indonesia

Overall Job Objectives

INITIA Group is seeking a detail-oriented and technically skilled Drafter to support our Project Operations team in developing accurate technical drawings for F&B, Wellness, and retail outlet construction and renovation projects in Indonesia.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for producing detailed architectural, interior, and technical drawings to support the execution of store fit-out, renovation, and new outlet development projects.   • Prepare detailed 2D and 3D drawings for architectural, interior, and fit-out projects

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture, Interior Design, Civil Engineering, or related field

  • Proficient in AutoCAD (mandatory)
  • Knowledge of SketchUp, 3D rendering software, or Revit is an advantage
  • Strong understanding of construction detailing, materials, and technical specifications
  • Ability to read and interpret architectural and interior design drawings
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Able to work under tight deadlines and manage multiple revisions
  • Good communication skills and ability to coordinate with project teams
  • Professional proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia; English is an advantage

Key Deliverables

  • Accurate and timely production of construction and shop drawings
  • Updated drawing revisions based on project requirements
  • Complete and well-organized drawing documentation for each project
  • Support for smooth project execution through precise technical detailing
  • Compliance with project design standards and construction requirements
  • Effective coordination with project and site teams

Benefits of the Role

  • Competitive monthly salary package
  • THR (Religious Holiday Allowance) in accordance with Indonesian labor law
  • BPJS Kesehatan and BPJS Ketenagakerjaan
  • Annual leave entitlement
  • Medical benefits
  • Performance-based project incentives (if applicable)
  • Staff discounts across INITIA Group brands
  • Career growth opportunities within a regional hospitality and development group
  • Exposure to premium F&B and wellness project developments
  • Collaborative and creative working environment

INITIA GROUP is the biggest brand concept leader in Singapore & Malaysia. We have been in the beauty and F&B industry for years and are now in Art, Retail, and Photo Studios. We are a fast-paced growing company, bringing all unique and on-trend concepts. We have a lot of expansions going on and we need additional talents in our growing family.

If you’re excited about our company’s vision for this position and want to start the path of becoming one of our future leaders, we’d like to hear from you.

Welcome to the world of intelligent product experiences powered by data ✨

If you’re excited about building machine learning systems that don’t just generate insights—but actually power meaningful product experiences used by real customers every day—you’re going to like it here.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join us at Paystone. In this role, you’ll help shape the future of how our products use data to drive smarter decisions, personalized experiences, and measurable business impact.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, and BI to turn rich transactional and behavioural data into models and recommendations that land directly in the hands of merchants. From customer segmentation and churn prediction to lifetime value modelling and personalized recommendations, your work will influence the experiences customers interact with daily.

This isn’t a “build a model and throw it over the wall” kind of role. You’ll own the modelling lifecycle end-to-end—from framing ambiguous business problems and shaping datasets to evaluating performance and partnering with engineering teams on how outputs are delivered in production.

At Paystone, we’re growing quickly, investing heavily in AI-augmented development, and building systems that help businesses move faster and smarter. We’re looking for someone who loves solving meaningful problems, thrives in fast-moving environments, and is excited about the future of agentic workflows and AI-assisted engineering.

We’re a team of curious builders who care deeply about what we create and how we create it. There’s room to experiment, room to lead, and room to make a real impact. We collaborate often, challenge ideas openly, and genuinely enjoy building alongside people who are passionate about solving hard problems well.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Partner with Product and BI to translate business goals into well-scoped modelling problems, with clear success criteria and guardrails.
  • Build and productionize models across areas such as customer segmentation, lifetime value, churn and retention, and personalised recommendations.
  • Design evaluation datasets, offline benchmarks, and online feedback loops so model quality is measured, not assumed.
  • Work with engineering on how model outputs are surfaced — latency, payload design, fallback behaviour, and failure modes are part of the job.
  • Monitor deployed models for drift and performance over time; own the retraining and improvement cadence.
  • Translate user feedback and product telemetry into concrete model and feature improvements.
  • Build alongside coding agents — drive agentic loops to scaffold pipelines, write and refactor production code, generate tests, and accelerate exploratory analysis, while keeping a human-in-the-loop for design and review decisions.
  • Communicate results and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

You might be a great fit if you:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, Applied Scientist, or ML Engineer shipping production models in a commercial software environment.
  • Expert-level SQL and Python, and comfort working with modern cloud data warehouses.
  • Production experience with at least two of: customer segmentation, churn or propensity modelling, lifetime value, or recommender systems.
  • A disciplined approach to evaluation — you define metrics up front, understand baselines, and guard against data leakage and overfitting.
  • Experience serving model outputs through APIs consumed by a product UI.
  • Hands-on fluency with coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agents, or similar) and genuine comfort operating in agentic loops — you can plan, prompt, review, iterate, and ship using agents as part of your everyday workflow.
  • A builder’s instinct for AI-assisted development: you know how to structure context, write clear specs, decompose work into agent-sized tasks, and verify outputs rigorously.
  • Clear written and verbal communication; you can defend a model choice and explain a result to someone who is not a data scientist.

Bonus points if you:

  • Have experience in loyalty, CRM, retail analytics, or related industries
  • Have worked with LLM-assisted analytics or conversational data systems
  • Have experience building custom AI agents, tools, MCP servers, or evaluating agent performance on real task
  • Are bilingual in English and French

If you’re excited about building intelligent systems that combine machine learning, product thinking, and AI-assisted development to create experiences that feel genuinely impactful—we’d love to meet you.

Quantum Realm Engineering is looking for a Sales and Business Development Manager to help source, qualify and close new client opportunities across software development, AI, websites, apps and digital product services.

A major part of this role is finding suitable companies online that may need help with their website, brand, app, internal systems, dashboards, client portals or digital workflows.

This is not a purely inbound sales role. You will be expected to research possible clients, identify decision-makers, start conversations and build relationships through LinkedIn, email, calls and other direct outreach methods.

The right person should be comfortable with sourcing new opportunities, but the sale itself is not short-term or transactional. We are looking for someone who can build trust, understand business problems and manage longer sales cycles for higher-value digital projects.

Role Focus

This role is focused on finding and selling opportunities such as:

  • Website redesigns and website rebuilds
  • Brand refresh projects
  • App rebuilds or app improvements
  • New web apps and mobile apps
  • AI agents and AI-powered systems
  • Internal dashboards and reporting tools
  • Client portals and online profiles
  • Business automation

The successful candidate will be responsible for sourcing new opportunities, starting conversations and helping move suitable leads towards signed projects.

Client Sourcing

Find companies online that may need a better website, app, brand presence, internal system, dashboard, client portal or digital product.

Research their current online presence and identify where Quantum Realm Engineering may be able to help.

Prospect Research

Build lists of suitable companies, founders, business owners, operators and decision-makers.

Identify the right person to contact and understand the likely business reason for reaching out.

Outreach

Start conversations through LinkedIn, email, phone calls and other direct outreach methods.

Write clear, personal and relevant messages that connect the prospect’s current business need to the services Quantum Realm Engineering can provide.

Lead Qualification

Qualify leads based on business need, budget, urgency, decision process and fit.

Separate serious opportunities from low-value or poor-fit enquiries.

Ask clear questions about what they need, what is currently not working and what commercial outcome they want from the project.

Proposal Support

Work with the internal team to prepare proposals, project outlines and follow-up material.

Make sure proposals are based on the client’s actual business problem, budget level and buying process.

Pipeline Management

Track leads, outreach, follow-ups, call notes, next steps and deal status clearly inside the CRM.

Keep the team updated on likely deal value, timing and closing risks.

Follow-Up and Closing

Manage follow-ups in a professional way.

Move suitable opportunities towards agreement, contract and project kick-off without overpromising.

Client Handover

Support a clean handover from sales to delivery.

Make sure the project team understands the client’s goals, expectations and key requirements.

description:
Insurance is one of the world's largest industries and one of the most painful to interact with. Paper forms. Sluggish call centres. Three-week underwriting cycles. Claims that vanish into queues. We are rebuilding all of it on top of a modern platform and AI agents that actually do the work, not pretend to.

You will not be picking up tickets. You will be deciding what to build, prototyping it on Monday, shipping a draft to a real customer by Friday, and improving it from real usage. We expect you to push the product, the codebase, and the way we work.

Why This Role Exists

We are looking for someone who treats AI as a creative material, not a feature on a roadmap. The next year of insurance is being defined right now. What gets automated, what gets reimagined, what gets thrown out. We want builders who want to be in that room and ship the answer.

The team is small. The mandate is large. If your highest-energy work has historically come from solving real problems end to end, this is the seat.

What You Will Do
  • Own outcomes, not tickets. Pick the biggest lever for our customers each sprint and drive it to live. Surface the next one yourself.
  • Build with AI as a primary tool, not a chatbot bolt-on. OCR, document understanding, generation, agent loops, evaluation harnesses. You decide where each fits.
  • Ship prototypes fast, then make them production-grade. A working demo on day three beats a perfect plan on day ten.
  • Work directly with customers. You will see real claims, real underwriting screens, real broker workflows. You will watch users hit dead ends and decide what to fix.
  • Raise the bar on the codebase. Reviews, refactors, testability, observability. Not as policy, as habit.
  • Push the team forward. Skills, agents, internal tools, engineering standards. Propose them, build them, get them adopted.
Who You Are
  • You ship. Ideas without execution do not count for you.
  • High agency. You do not wait for a card to be assigned. You see what is worth doing and you start.
  • Strong opinions, loosely held. You make calls with incomplete information and change your mind when the evidence shifts.
  • Curious about the domain. Insurance is messy and full of weird incentives. That intrigues you, not annoys you.
  • Fluent with AI. You have shipped something real with LLMs or agents. You know where the magic ends and where you have to engineer carefully.
  • Care about humans on the other end. Insurance done right gives people peace of mind in their worst weeks. That is the point.
Your Toolbox

We use Node.js + TypeScript + Nest.js on the back end, Vue (and some React) on the front end, GraphQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS. AI work spans OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, plus a growing set of in-house skills and agents. You do not need to have used every piece. You do need to be the kind of engineer who picks up a new tool and is shipping with it within the week.

What We Expect at This Level
  • 6+ years building production systems. Track record of complex, customer-facing software shipped, not just maintained.
  • Real AI experience. You have built and shipped at least one substantive AI-driven feature. POCs that died in a notebook do not count here.
  • Strong fundamentals. OO, design patterns, testing, web security, performance. You do not need a refresher.
  • Cloud comfort. AWS, Azure, or GCP. At least one in depth, the rest enough to hold a conversation.
  • Communication. You can explain a tradeoff to a non-technical stakeholder in two minutes and to an engineer in one.
Not Suitable for the Role If…
  • You prefer tickets assigned to you over choosing what to build.
  • You measure your work in lines of code, not outcomes.
  • You see AI as a buzzword to put on your CV rather than a tool you have actually used in anger.
  • You want a process-heavy environment with detailed specs handed down from product.
  • You are looking for a maintenance role on a finished platform.
Why CoverGo

Insurance is the rare industry where AI can save people hours of their worst weeks. We are already shipping AI-powered claims, underwriting, distribution, and document automation to enterprise carriers across five continents. The platform is real. The customers are real. The next chapter is yours to help write.
